description: This file defines external ADC interface functions and macros, referencing MCP3208 ADC hardware, and includes some inline conversion utilities. It appears to be part of a hardware layer for firmware ADC handling.

methods.name: getAdcValue
methods.description: Macro for retrieving ADC value from a specified channel via getMcp3208adc.

methods.name: adcToVoltsDivided
methods.description: Calculates voltage from ADC value, assuming a 5V reference and 12-bit ADC resolution.

methods.name: getVoltageDivided
methods.description: Returns divided voltage reading based on channel; special value if channel is EFI_ADC_NONE.
